verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Angular's strict template type-checking (e.g., strictTemplates compiler option) that would demonstrate compile-time checking inside templates; the only relevant community evidence (angular-comm-3) explicitly states 'Compilers can't find typos' in templates, contradicting the story rather than supporting it. Missing for 10: any first-party docs on template type checking, strictTemplates/fullTemplateTypeCheck options, or independent hands-on confirmation that template compile errors are caught.
